<!doctype html>
<html lang="zh-CN">
<head>
<meta charset="utf-8"/>
<style>
  html,body{margin:0;padding:0;width:1920px;height:1080px;overflow:hidden;background:#F5F2E9;}
  *{box-sizing:border-box;}
  :root{
    --bg:#F5F2E9;
    --surface:#F3F0E7;
    --ink:#1B2620;
    --muted:#5C665D;
    --primary:#4F5E43;
    --secondary:#B4914A;
    --tertiary:#8C9FB2;
    --line:#A3AC9E;
    --serif:Georgia,'Times New Roman','Songti SC','Source Han Serif SC','Noto Serif SC','SimSun',serif;
    --sans:'Helvetica Neue',Arial,'PingFang SC','Hiragino Sans GB','Microsoft YaHei',sans-serif;
  }
  .slide{
    position:relative;
    width:1920px;
    height:1080px;
    overflow:hidden;
    background:var(--bg);
    color:var(--ink);
    font-family:var(--sans);
  }

  /* ---------- paper field ---------- */
  .bg-field{
    position:absolute;left:0;top:0;width:1920px;height:1080px;z-index:0;
    background:
      radial-gradient(1100px 780px at 3% 0%,rgba(180,145,74,.10),transparent 70%),
      radial-gradient(900px 760px at 52% 58%,rgba(140,159,178,.10),transparent 70%),
      radial-gradient(950px 760px at 97% 97%,rgba(79,94,67,.10),transparent 72%),
      linear-gradient(168deg,#F8F5EC 0%,#F5F2E9 55%,#EFECE1 100%);
  }
  .bg-field::after{
    content:"";position:absolute;left:0;top:0;width:1920px;height:1080px;
    background:repeating-linear-gradient(90deg,rgba(27,38,32,.04) 0 1px,transparent 1px 160px);
  }

  /* soft vertical prism band between columns */
  .band{
    position:absolute;left:1104px;top:0;width:78px;height:1080px;z-index:1;
    background:linear-gradient(180deg,rgba(140,159,178,.20),rgba(140,159,178,.05) 62%,rgba(140,159,178,0));
  }
  .band::after{
    content:"";position:absolute;left:52px;top:0;width:26px;height:1080px;
    background:rgba(255,255,255,.42);
  }

  /* dot fields */
  .dots{
    position:absolute;left:860px;top:0;width:520px;height:132px;z-index:1;opacity:.22;
    background-image:radial-gradient(circle,rgba(27,38,32,.55) 1.05px,transparent 1.15px);
    background-size:15px 15px;
  }
  .dots2{
    position:absolute;left:1240px;top:792px;width:500px;height:112px;z-index:1;opacity:.18;
    background-image:radial-gradient(circle,rgba(27,38,32,.55) 1.05px,transparent 1.15px);
    background-size:15px 15px;
  }

  /* register ornament */
  .register{
    position:absolute;right:-170px;top:-190px;width:500px;height:500px;
    border-radius:50%;border:1px solid rgba(27,38,32,.26);z-index:2;pointer-events:none;
  }
  .register .r2{position:absolute;left:14px;top:14px;right:14px;bottom:14px;border-radius:50%;border:1px solid rgba(27,38,32,.16);}
  .register .r3{position:absolute;left:42px;top:42px;right:42px;bottom:42px;border-radius:50%;
    background:conic-gradient(from 200deg,rgba(79,94,67,.18),rgba(79,94,67,0) 26%,rgba(140,159,178,.28) 52%,rgba(140,159,178,.06) 78%,rgba(79,94,67,.18));}
  .register .r4{position:absolute;left:58px;top:58px;right:58px;bottom:58px;border-radius:50%;
    background:rgba(245,242,233,.82);border:1px solid rgba(27,38,32,.07);}
  .register .dot{
    position:absolute;left:68px;top:420px;width:12px;height:12px;border-radius:50%;
    background:var(--secondary);box-shadow:0 0 0 5px rgba(180,145,74,.12);
  }

  /* left rail */
  .rail{position:absolute;left:92px;top:300px;width:1px;height:470px;background:rgba(27,38,32,.16);z-index:4;}
  .rail-text{
    position:absolute;left:62px;top:762px;z-index:4;
    transform:rotate(-90deg);transform-origin:left top;
    font-size:12px;letter-spacing:5px;color:#6b766d;white-space:nowrap;
  }

  /* header */
  .hd-no{position:absolute;left:120px;top:88px;z-index:8;font-size:15px;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:2px;color:var(--secondary);}
  .hd-div{position:absolute;left:176px;top:92px;width:1px;height:18px;background:rgba(27,38,32,.32);z-index:8;}
  .hd-label{position:absolute;left:198px;top:90px;z-index:8;font-size:14px;font-weight:600;letter-spacing:5px;color:#4f5b53;}
  .top-rule{position:absolute;left:120px;top:140px
